name: @openbuddy/dsh-core
description: Phase B.3 step 2b — DSH core state machines as PI-native extensions. Extracts the per-session goal + message-feedback state machines from electron/main/agent/host-modules/bootstrap/wire-dsh-services.ts into PI ExtensionFactory wrappers that can be loaded by PI discoverAndLoadExtensions() instead of the legacy DSH HarnessPluginLoader.
